edited_fraction: unclear (budgets of 33 to ~8,192 editable native coordinates; total model sizes not given)
evidence_notes: The LLM-guided editing loop is the paper's method (p.1-3): DeepSeek or Claude propose which native coordinates to edit and the fitting objective, while ridge/Adam solvers compute the patches, with internal validation feedback each round (p.1, p.3-4), so solver_delegated and closed loop. Baselines include Adam fine-tuning of a local subset, Memory and output calibration (Calib) and non-LLM HypoLoop variants (Table 1, p.5); DeepSeek performs at least as well as Claude (e.g. Burgers 58.8% vs 47.7%, p.1). No preregistration; code at github.com/limengran98/HypoLoop (p.1); Codex (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol) assisted with code and language editing (p.8).
